chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from Ibn Fazzal, from Ibn Bukayr, who said:
I heard Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) saying: 'The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) married Fatima (peace be upon her) upon a cracked shield valued at thirty dirhams.'

key_terms.ثَلَاثِينَ دِرْهَماً: Thirty dirhams, the monetary value of the dowry
key_terms.دِرْعٍ حُطَمِيَّةٍ: A cracked or worn shield, used as the dowry
key_terms.زَوَّجَ: He married (someone) / He gave in marriage

ai.seo_question: What was the dowry given to Fatima (AS) during her marriage to Imam Ali (AS)?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Al-Kafi* highlights the asceticism (zuhd) of Imam Ali (as) by specifying that the dowry for Fatima (as) was a simple, slightly worn shield valued at only thirty dirhams. In Shia tradition, this incident is frequently cited to demonstrate that the Ahl al-Bayt prioritized spiritual purity and modesty over material wealth, setting a precedent for marital simplicity. The 'hutamiyyah' (cracked shield) symbolizes readiness for sacrifice and the transient nature of worldly possessions.
